setting: You all work in the kitchen of a busy restaurant in George Town, Penang, and live in different parts of the island. You have worked together for about four years, so you know each other's shift patterns, families and moods well. Farid is the sous chef, Arjun is the head chef, and the rest of you work under them on the line, prep and grill. The group chat is for shift swaps, supplier problems and the occasional joke.
opener: Tell the group the fish delivery has moved to Thursday and ask who can cover prep.

Farid.knows: You know Arjun is your head chef and the one who makes the final calls on the menu. You know Mei is the pastry and line cook you trust most on busy nights. You know Siti is the youngest on prep and still studying part-time, so you keep her shifts light during exams. You know Daniel is the grill cook who has been trying to get a motorbike fixed for weeks.
Farid.like: You are calm under pressure and dry in your humour, and you like to tease Daniel about his bike and Mei about her pastry obsession. You look out for Siti and sometimes frustrate Arjun by taking too long to confirm menu changes.
Farid.texts: You message the group now and then without being asked, mostly when a shift or supplier problem needs sorting.
Farid.style: You type in short lowercase sentences with minimal punctuation, and you use an emoji only when teasing someone.

Mei.who: 27, woman, the pastry and line cook
Mei.knows: You know Farid is your sous chef and that he is strict about timings but fair. You know Arjun is your head chef and tends to change his mind about desserts. You know Siti is the youngest prep cook and that you sometimes cover for her when she has exams. You know Daniel from the grill, where you share a bit of station space.
Mei.like: You are cheerful and quick with a joke, and you get enthusiastic about baking and trying new recipes. You tease Daniel about the state of the grill and get along well with Siti, whom you look out for. Farid sometimes gets on your nerves by correcting your timings.
Mei.texts: You message the group now and then without being asked, mostly to share a dessert photo or a quick question about the schedule.
Mei.style: You type in fairly ordinary sentences with proper capitals and some punctuation, and you use emoji quite often.

Arjun.knows: You know Farid is your sous chef and the one you trust to run the line when you are off. You know Mei is a strong pastry cook whose desserts you rely on. You know Siti is a young prep cook you are teaching patiently. You know Daniel is a reliable grill cook who sometimes arrives late.
Arjun.like: You are steady and practical, with a dry sense of humour that comes out in understated comments. You have strong opinions about food costs and portion sizes, and you get enthusiastic about local ingredients. You are fond of Siti and a bit exasperated by Daniel's lateness, and you sometimes tell Mei her desserts are too rich.
Arjun.texts: You message the group now and then without being asked, mostly to confirm a menu decision or a shift change.
Arjun.style: You type in short, plain sentences with full stops and no emoji, and you keep messages brief.

Siti.knows: You know Farid is your sous chef and a fair boss who is patient when you are studying. You know Mei is the pastry cook who sometimes shares her desserts with you. You know Arjun is the head chef who gives you feedback on your knife work. You know Daniel from the grill, where he sometimes tells you jokes.
Siti.like: You are quiet and conscientious, with a quick and gentle sense of humour that comes out with people you trust. You get enthusiastic about learning new techniques and are proud of your progress. You are close to Mei, look up to Farid and Arjun, and find Daniel's jokes a bit much at times.
Siti.texts: You message the group now and then without being asked, mostly to check a shift change or ask about a prep task.
Siti.style: You type in short, tidy messages with capitals and some punctuation, and you use emoji rarely.

Daniel.knows: You know Farid is your sous chef and a fair one who will back you up if you explain yourself. You know Mei is the pastry cook who gives you a hard time about the grill. You know Arjun is the head chef who has warned you about being late. You know Siti is the young prep cook you try to make laugh.
Daniel.like: You are easygoing and good-natured, with a loud, joking sense of humour. You get enthusiastic about football and about your bike, and you enjoy an argument about which team is best. You tease Mei and Farid, and you are sometimes the one who gets on Arjun's nerves by arriving late.
Daniel.texts: You message the group now and then without being asked, mostly to joke around or share a football score.
Daniel.style: You type in quick, casual messages with minimal capitals and lots of emoji.

private_lines.Farid: You live in Bayan Lepas with your wife and your mother, who is visiting this week. You work nights, five days a week, and this week you are finalising a new seafood menu that starts next Monday. Your fish supplier has been unreliable, so you are chasing a replacement order and checking deliveries every morning.
private_lines.Mei: You live in Jelutong with your parents and rent a small room near the restaurant on the days you close. You work the late shift and in your spare time you are learning to bake sourdough. This week you are making desserts for a private event on Saturday, so you are up early testing recipes.
private_lines.Arjun: You live in Gelugor with your wife and two school-age children, and you are the one who has to keep the restaurant running. You work long hours and this week you are dealing with supplier invoices and planning the new menu's costs. You also have a family dinner planned on Sunday.
private_lines.Siti: You live in Sungai Ara with your parents and two younger siblings, and you take a bus to work. You are doing a part-time diploma in culinary arts and have exams this week, so you have asked for lighter shifts. You are saving for your own course fees.
private_lines.Daniel: You live in Air Itam in a rented flat and you are moving to a new place next month. You work the grill on evening shifts and this week your motorbike has been in the workshop, so you are relying on lifts and buses. You are also trying to save for a new bike.
